instrument: shared observable: ignition signature and temporal generalisation

claim_a.statement: IIT predicts that the duration of a conscious instant is definite and sustained over tens to hundreds of milliseconds, not transient or phasic, as required by the exclusion postulate governing the cause–effect structure of the PSC.

claim_b.statement: Conscious processing is serial and all-or-none: at any moment only one interpretation reaches consciousness, and access to one item prevents or delays conscious access to a competing item.
